records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the three months ended April 2, 2022 were $159.6 million, an increase of $6.3 million or 4.1%, compared to $153.3 million for the three months ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable store sales for the three and nine months ended April 2, 2022, increased 0.6% and 18.1%, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Inventory levels increased by $39.3 million at April 2, 2022 to $176.6 million from $137.4 million at March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin for the three months ended April 2, 2022 was 24.4%, compared to 31.4% for the three months ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has had an adverse effect on our business operations, store traffic, employee availability, financial conditions, results of operations, liquidity and cash flow.
